description: Re-engineering of the National Institute of Sports Science for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2013-11-29
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports, to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill for the purpose, in keeping with the present day and future needs of the country, was approved by the Cabinet.
